column2: WARNING Breaker Test Plug Removal Sign – Test Circuits May Remain Live – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Test Circuits May Remain Live. This WARNING Breaker Test Plug Removal sign from CGAP Safety reads: BREAKER TEST PLUG REMOVAL / TEST CIRCUITS MAY REMAIN LIVE / ISOLATE TEST POWER AND VERIFY / BEFORE REMOVING THE PLUG. Written for Electric utilities, substations, power generating plants.

Why this sign matters

Test circuits that connect through the plug can remain energized even when the breaker is open. Pulling the plug can expose the technician to shock or an arc burn.

Where to post it

Mount the sign on the breaker cubicle door beside the test plug receptacle in the switchgear room.

Who orders it

Substation technicians, protection and control engineers and safety officers.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.269; NFPA 70E; ANSI Z535.2. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.
